market_question: Will Mirra Andreeva win the 2026 Women’s French Open?
reasoning: Mirra Andreeva is a talented teenager but has yet to consistently compete with top-5 players. Winning a Grand Slam before age 20 is historically rare; current favorites Iga Swiatek, Aryna Sabalenka, and others are in their prime and dominate clay. A 3.5% true probability is generous for an outsider a year out.
evidence_points: Andreeva's career-high ranking is around #30, with no Grand Slam titles or finals to date.
Only three teenagers have won a WTA major in the last decade (Swiatek, Gauff, Raducanu), and all were unexpected breakthroughs.
The 2026 French Open field projects to include multiple multi-Slam winners like Swiatek, who is overwhelming favorite on clay.
sources_consulted: WTA official rankings and match records
